episodes.title: The Last Real Journalist Working in Denver
episodes.summary: Frustrated and stuck at an unfulfilling job, disgraced journalist Beth Burgess finds possible redemption in the story of a lifetime when Toni Plimpton, an incarcerated mother convicted of murdering her husband Wallace, reaches out to her to help prove her innocence.

episodes.title: Crazy Bitches Who Kill
episodes.summary: After realizing that Toni is courting other journalists, Beth tracks down Toni's unsavory brother-in-law, Wyatt, and his hotheaded business partner, George, to begin her investigation into the events that led to Wallace's murder.

episodes.title: You Might Be All She's Got
episodes.summary: Having landed Toni's story, Beth immediately runs into obstacles when given an expedited deadline from her editor and while investigating Wyatt's alibi at an unusual tanning salon.

episodes.title: Let's Make This Man Hurt
episodes.summary: After getting a new lead from Toni and with an assist from George, Beth and Fiona attend a unique wedding in hopes of finding the notorious gun-trafficker, Tuna.

episodes.title: Stop Being a Coward and Take the Meat
episodes.summary: Beth and Toni's bond grows despite some setbacks in Beth's investigation. Meanwhile, Fiona gets the credit for busting the illegal gun ring and putting Tuna behind bars, giving Beth an opportunity to question him about Wallace's murder.

episodes.title: Your Mama Loves You
episodes.summary: With Wyatt and George temporarily skipping town, Beth takes the opportunity to look for more leads by breaking into Wyatt's home. What she finds draws her closer to Toni, until she makes a sinister discovery.

episodes.title: A Denver Ten
episodes.summary: Feeling less confident of Toni's innocence after seeing her texts, Beth tracks down Toni's old best friend to get some answers while Marco's patience and support waivers.

episodes.title: I Thought We Were Friends
episodes.summary: As their lies and deceptions intensify, Beth and Toni confront each other during a revealing visitation, and lay everything on the table.

episodes.title: Acts of Devotion
episodes.summary: Her vigor renewed, Beth finishes the story, giving Toni new hope. However, when no publication will run it, Beth turns to her mother for help and confronts multiple truths in the process.

episodes.title: Guilty Party
episodes.summary: Season finale. Beth and Toni, both desperate to survive, realize that the truth may not always set you free.
